protected_rules: Memory is never canonical evidence by itself.
Current explicit user input is authoritative for user intent and requested scope, not for objective project or system facts.
Decision-ready user intent does not authorize a consequential action or bypass capability and approval controls.
Current project and runtime facts require inspectable canonical evidence when decision-relevant.
Unsupported remembered facts fail closed for R3/R4 decisions.
Canonical conflict cannot be resolved by silently preferring memory.
Blocked claims cannot be promoted until the blocking conflict or missing material evidence is resolved.
Absence from memory is not evidence of absence.
Reusable remembered guidance requires provenance, scope and verification before promotion.
Memory correction does not mutate canonical knowledge automatically.
Canonical updates do not imply remembered summaries are already refreshed.
Promotion that changes Active reusable guidance must pass the Source Delta Pipeline.
Unknown Source Delta applicability blocks Knowledge Base promotion until changes_active_guidance is explicitly assessed.
Current explicit user intent may be persisted project-locally but cannot directly become global reusable knowledge; Knowledge Base promotion requires a separate corroborated claim.
No USER_INTENT record may directly promote to KNOWLEDGE_BASE; global reusable guidance requires a separate corroborated claim.
Duplicate JSON keys are invalid because ambiguous input must not rely on parser last-wins behavior.
changes_active_guidance applies only to KNOWLEDGE_BASE promotion; project-local promotion cannot claim to change Active global guidance.
